en.headline: CLP freezes basic tariff as net rates rise 1.8 percent for 2027
en.dek: The utility will hold the average basic tariff at 101.2 cents per unit from 1 January while the fuel adjustment lifts the average net tariff to 143.2 cents, with HK Electric raising its net rate by 7.9 percent.
body: CLP Power announced on Tuesday that it will freeze the average basic tariff at 101.2 cents per unit of electricity from 1 January 2027, the same level as in 2026, while the fuel cost adjustment will rise by 2.6 cents to 42 cents.

As a result the average net tariff for January 2027 will be 143.2 cents per unit, an increase of about 1.8 percent from January 2026. Managing Director Joseph Law said the company would draw about HK$2.5 billion from the tariff stabilisation fund and fuel clause recovery account to freeze the basic tariff and limit the fuel adjustment rise amid volatile international fuel prices linked to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.

HK Electric said its average net tariff would rise 7.9 percent to 176.2 cents per unit from January, with the basic tariff at 128.9 cents and the fuel adjustment at 47.3 cents. Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan told lawmakers the fuel-price surge since the Middle East crisis in March was the main driver, and the government was determined to address the structural gap between the two companies’ rates by not approving new fossil-fuel generators and planning to import more zero-carbon power.

zh.headline: 中電明年凍結基本電價 淨電費上調1.8% 港燈加7.9%
zh.dek: 中電由明年1月1日起凍結平均基本電價於每度電101.2港仙，燃料調整費上調後平均淨電價為143.2港仙，港燈平均淨電價則上調7.9%至176.2港仙。
body: 中華電力周二宣布，2027年1月1日起平均基本電價將凍結於每度電101.2港仙，與2026年水平相同，燃料調整費則上調2.6港仙至42港仙。
調整後，2027年1月平均淨電價為每度電143.2港仙，較2026年1月上升約1.8%。總裁羅嘉進表示，面對中東地緣局勢導致國際燃料價格波動，中電將從電費穩定基金及燃料價格調整條款賬合共撥出約25億港元，以凍結基本電價並盡量減低燃料調整費升幅。
港燈方面，明年1月平均淨電價將上調7.9%至每度電176.2港仙，基本電價為128.9港仙，燃料調整費為47.3港仙。環境及生態局局長謝展寰向立法會議員表示，今年3月中東危機後燃料價格大幅上升是主因，政府決心處理兩電電費差距擴大的結構性問題，將不再批准新的化石燃料發電機組，並計劃引入更多零碳電力。
